title: Letter to the editor: Centennial School District teachers deserve a contract - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago My name is Molly Fox Zhu, and I am the parent of a 4th grader and a 5th grader at Pleasant Valley Elementary in the Centennial School District. My kids love school. What they treasure most is not the shared laughter with friends at recess. It’s not even Miss Wilma, whose dual duty as custodian and Lunch Lady affords her a nearly legendary status. It’s their teachers. Their teachers provide not only instruction, but safe and welcoming spaces. The teachers at Pleasant Valley challenge and support their students both academically and socially. They model how to be a good human and a critical thinker. They don’t just teach my kids, they see them. These educators spend more waking hours during the school week with our kids than we do, so the quality of their dedication and instruction is truly something to be grateful for. Pleasant Valley is not just a school; it’s a house of belonging. Read full article
